title: Targets vs Actual
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: EMEA vs target
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(a.actual) / sum(t.revenue_target), 2) FROM dash_demo.sales_targets t LEFT JOIN (SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts) AS m, g.region, sum(o.total_amount) AS actual FROM dash_demo.orders o JOIN dash_demo.geo_cities g ON g.city_id = o.city_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY 1, 2) a ON a.m = t.month AND a.region = t.region WHERE year(t.month) = 2026 AND t.region = 'EMEA'

density.bucket: region x month cell, on average
density.rule: a heatmap needs 50 per cell on average
density.sql: SELECT round(count(*) / (count(DISTINCT g.region) * count(DISTINCT date_trunc('month', o.order_ts))), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o JOIN dash_demo.geo_cities g ON g.city_id = o.city_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND year(o.order_ts) = 2026
